# hallpass_notification_route (Resource)

Sends approval requests for matching servers to a Slack channel or Telegram chat. Routes cannot be edited in place: every change replaces the route. Import with the route ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hallpass_notification_route" "prod" {
  integration_id = hallpass_integration.slack.id
  destination    = "C0123456789"
  targets        = { server_labels = { match_labels = { env = "prod" } } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) Slack channel ID (`C…`) or Telegram chat ID. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `integration_id` (String) Integration ID (`int_…`). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `targets` (Attributes) Requests for which servers and git remotes go to this chat. Changing it forces a new route. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether messages are sent. Changing it forces a new route.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Route ID (`rte_…`).

<a id="nestedatt--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targets`

Optional:

- `all` (Boolean) Match every server and git remote, including ones created later.
- `server_groups` (Set of String) Server group names.
- `server_labels` (Attributes) Servers by label. Every `match_labels` pair and every expression must hold. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets--server_labels))
- `servers` (Set of String) Server and git remote IDs (`srv_…`).

<a id="nestedatt--targets--server_labels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targets.server_labels`

Optional:

- `match_expressions` (Attributes List) Label expressions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets--server_labels--match_expressions))
- `match_labels` (Map of String) Labels that must have exactly these values.

<a id="nestedatt--targets--server_labels--match_expressions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targets.server_labels.match_expressions`

Required:

- `key` (String) Label key.
- `operator` (String) `In`, `NotIn`, `Exists` or `DoesNotExist`.

Optional:

- `values` (Set of String) Values for `In` and `NotIn`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Route ID
terraform import hallpass_notification_route.prod rte_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8j
```
